why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Edmundo Sosa is slot #4 (4.895 expected team runs/game).
Slots #4, #5, #6, #7, #8, #3, #9, #2, #1 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #5 ranks 2 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.001 R/G.
Slot #4 yields 4.41 expected PA/game vs 4.30 at primary slot #5. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
